paite: Hezekiah in kum sawmnih-le-nga upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Abijah, Zekariah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah / (2 Kum 18.1-3)

paite: Ama'n apu David thilhih bang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi.
Ama'n vaihawm apat kum akha khatna ah TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong a, azemhoih hi.
heading: Tempul Hahsianna

paite: Siampute leh Levite apilut a, suahlam sang mun za lai ah apikhawm a, akiang uah,
"Nou Levite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; noute kihihsiangthou phot unla, huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian inn hihsiangthou unla, mun siangthou a kipan ninte paikhia un.
I pi-le-pute un thil ahihkhialta ua, TOUPA Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ana hih ua, ana lehngatsan ua, TOUPA omna alehngatsan ua, ana nungngatta uhi.
Inn lim kongkhakte akhak ua, khawnvakte ahihmit ua, Israel' Pathian' mun siangthou ah gimlimte ahal kei ua, halmang thillatte leng alan kei uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah a-om a, na mit ua na muh bang un, gam chih mual chih a sepsep ding leh lamdangsak ding leh nuihzat ding in ana bawlta ahi.
Ngai dih ua, i pi-le-pute uh namsau a vuallelhsak in a-om ua, i tanu leh i tapate uh, i zite uh, huaiziak in sal in ana om uhi.
"Ngai dih ua, ahehna mahmah athentheihna ding in TOUPA Israel' Pathian kiang ah thu khun ka tum hi.
Ka naute aw don lou in om kei un, TOUPA nasem na hi ua, ama a nasem a om ding leh gimlim halmi ding in nou ahon telta ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Levi mi Amasai tapa Mahathte, Kohath mi Azariah tapa Joelte; Merari tapate lak a Abdi tapa Kishte, Jehalleleel tapa Azariah, Gershon, Zimmah tapa Joah, Joah tapa Edente,
Elizaphan tapate lak a mi Shimri leh Jeuelte: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Mataniahte;
Heman tapate lak a mi Jehuel leh Shimeite; Jeduthun tapate lak a mi Shemaiah leh Uzzielte akuankhia uhi.
A-unaute uh asamkhawm ua, akihihsiangthou ua, TOUPA thu a kumpipa thupiak bang a TOUPA' inn hihsiang ding in alutta uhi.
Huchi in kihihsiang ding in TOUPA insung gil lam ah siampute alut ua, TOUPA' inn a thilnin amuh tengteng uh TOUPA inkong ah alakhia uhi.
Akha khatna ani khat ni in apan ua, huai kha ani giat ni in TOUPA inlim atung ua; huchi in ani giat in TOUPA' inn ahihsiangthou ua; akha khatna ani sawm-le-guk ni in azou vek uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah kumpipa' inn ah alut ua, "TOUPA' inn a halmang thillatna maitamte, huai a tui-um belsuan tengteng, tanghou siahna dohkante, huai a vanzat tengtengte ka hihsiang vekta uh.
heading: Tempul Lat Thak Nawnna

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in avaihawm lai a thil ahihkhelh a, apaihmang tui-um belsuan tengteng leng ka bawl zou vek ua, ka hihsiangthou lai ua; huan, ngai dih, TOUPA maitam malam ah a-om hi," achi uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah bel zingkhang in athou a, khua a miliante asamkhawm a, TOUPA' inn ah ahoh uhi.
Gam, mun siangthou leh Judate a ding a khelh thoihna ding bawngtal sagih, belamtal sagih, belamnou sagih leh keltal sagih akaitou ua. Aaron tapa siampute TOUPA maitam a lan ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in bawngtalte agou ua; siampute'n sisan ala ua, maitam atheh ua: belamtalte agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh ua; belamnoute leng agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh uhi.
Huan keltalte khelh thoihna ding in kumpipa leh mipite kiang ah ahon kai ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
Siampute'n agou ua, Israel mi tengteng a ding a lemna bawlna ding in asisan un maitam ah khelh thoihna alan ua; kumpipa thupiak bang in Israel mi tengteng a ding in alan uhi.

Huchi in David leh kumpipa zawlnei Gad leh zawlnei Nathan thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ah Levite dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte tum ding in akoih a; thupiak a zawlneite zang a TOUPA piak lah ahi ngal a.
Levite bel David bawl tumging chi toh siampute pengkul toh adingh uhi.
Huan Hezekiah in maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in thu apia a. Halmang thillat ahon lat pat un TOUPA la pengkul leh Israel kumpipa David bawl tumging toh ahon sa uhi.
Huchi in mipite'n Pathian abia ua, lasiamte'n la asa ua, pengkul mut mite'n amut ua, halmang thillat lat khit ahih masiah huchibang in ahih nilouh uhi.
Thillat alat khit un kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng in kun in Pathian abia uhi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah leh miliante'n Levite bel David leh zawlnei Asaph phuah phatna la sa ding in thu apia uhi. Huchi in nuamsatak in phatna la asa ua, akun ua, Pathian abia uhi.

Huchi in Hezekiah in, "TOUPA a ding in na kihihsiangthouta ua, hong nai unla, TOUPA' inn ah kithoihna leh kipahthu genna thillat hong lan un," achi hi. Mipite'n kithoihnate, kipahthu genna thillatte ahon lan ua, a-ut peuhmah in halmang thillat ahon lan uhi.
Mipite'n halmang thillat ahong lat zah uh bawngtal sawmsagih leh belamtal zakhat leh belamnou zanih ahi. Hiaite tengteng TOUPA a dia halmang thillat ding vek ahi.
Thillat tengteng bawngtal zaguk, belamtal sangthum ahi.

Himahleh siampu atawm lua ua, halmang thillat pen asem seng kei ua; huaiziak in a-unaute Levite'n akimansak ma un siampute kihihsiangthou tan in ahuh uhi. Levite siampute sang in kihihsiangthou thu ah angentelzaw uhi.
Huchi in halmang thillatte atam a, halmang thillat chih a ding a lemna thillat thaute, dawn ding thillat a dingte leng atam mahmah hi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn nasepdan hoihtak in ahih uhi.
Pathian in mite kisakholsak khin a, kintak a thil atunsak a, thil om guih ahih ziak in, Hezekia leh mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
